svg.title: AI proposes, rules dispose: the boundary around Cedar's suggested case category
svg.desc: Left to right. 1, a case is created from an e-mail; the agent flow takes subject and body, trimmed, with HTML removed. 2, the prompt Cedar - Suggest case category, version 2: the e-mail is marked as data between markers, temperature 0, GPT-4.1 mini which is generally available, JSON output with a fixed format, at most 100 seconds. 3, the guard, deterministic code: parse exactly one JSON object; category and priority from closed lists, anything else rejected; confidence between 0 and 1; below 0.7 or with injection phrases in the e-mail, needs review; links, e-mail addresses and phone numbers removed from the reason. 4, only suggestion columns are written: suggested category, suggested priority, confidence, reason and status Suggested, Needs review or Rejected; never Case category, priority, owner or queue. 5, Omar confirms or corrects the category; the business rule CASE-BR1, urgent equals priority High plus Critical fault, and the routing rules run deterministically on what Omar set. Below, the release gate before the flow is turned on: the evaluation set of 20 labelled e-mails measured through the guard; accuracy of shown suggestions at least 0.9, rejected answers at most 5 percent, complaint recall at least 0.9, coverage at least 0.6, and no injection item passing as a plain suggestion. Version 1 of the prompt failed, version 2 passed. After release, the acceptance rate of suggestions is monitored and the evaluation is repeated when the model, the prompt or the region changes.
svg.text: Release gate (tools/evaluate-suggestions.mjs), before the flow is turned on in an environment
20 labelled e-mails (data/ai/case-category-evalset.json), recorded model answers measured THROUGH the guard:
• accuracy of shown suggestions ≥ 0.9 • rejected answers ≤ 5 % • complaint recall ≥ 0.9 • coverage ≥ 0.6
• no injection item may pass as a plain suggestion
Version 1 of the prompt: FAILED (0.875, 10 %, recall 0.4, followed the injection). Version 2: PASSED (0.944, 0 %, recall 1.0).
Monitor how often Omar keeps the suggestion. Repeat the evaluation when the prompt, the model, the model version or the region
changes. The default model is upgraded over time: an upgrade is a change that needs the gate.
